Contact

Email banksmi@mail.com or open an issue on the GitHub project. Please include your device model, Android or Fire OS version, app version and the steps that led to the problem. Never attach private books, notes or full backups to a public issue.

A document will not open

Check that it is a supported PDF or DRM-free EPUB under 100 MB. Encrypted EPUBs, unsafe archive paths and excessive expanded sizes are rejected. No OCR or protected Kindle support is included.

Voice is unavailable

Use the text command field or touch controls. Check installed speech services and permissions. Voice availability differs by tablet.

Before reinstalling

Export JSON to keep your metadata and journal. Keep original document files separately, because backups do not include them.
